items.name: Baby Missile
items.description: Reliable explosive shell. Unlimited ammunition.

items.name: Missile
items.description: Three heavy shells. Wider blasts, deeper craters, 120 peak damage.

items.name: Crumble cannon
items.description: Three shells that crumble solid ground into falling debris. 65 peak damage.

items.name: Riot Bomb
items.description: Three terrain-clearing riot shells. A broad crater with no blast damage.

items.name: Battery
items.description: Two repairs. Restore up to 30 hull each during your turn without ending it.

items.name: Bouncer cannon
items.description: Three bouncing shells. A four-second fuse keeps them dangerous after landing.

items.name: Jetpack fuel
items.description: Six seconds of thrust using the tank's levitation controller.

items.name: Burrowing rig
items.description: Five seconds of powered tunneling through the ground.

items.name: Sand charge cannon
items.description: Charges release a seeded, noise-filled bank of real sand at impact.

recipe.name: Indigo sand bank
recipe.description: Seeded native noise deposits loose sand in empty cells.

items.name: Mag Deflector
items.description: A powered field that bends incoming metal shells away.

items.name: Shield
items.description: Absorbs incoming damage before it reaches the hull.

items.name: Baby Nuke
items.description: A compact nuclear shell: 150 peak damage and a 104-pixel crater.

items.name: Nuke
items.description: A very large nuclear shell: 220 peak damage and a 176-pixel crater.

items.name: Leap Frog
items.description: Three consecutive explosive hops. The second and third warheads launch from the previous impact.

items.name: Funky Bomb
items.description: A chaotic blast scattering seven live secondary warheads.

items.name: MIRV
items.description: Splits into five descending warheads at the apex. Early impact releases the payload against the obstruction.

items.name: Death’s Head
items.description: Nine large warheads at the apex. Allow plenty of clearance.

items.name: Napalm
items.description: Deposits real burning fuel at impact. Fire and oil continue simulating after the turn.

items.name: Hot Napalm
items.description: Deposits real burning fuel at impact. Fire and oil continue simulating after the turn.

items.name: Tracer
items.description: A harmless ballistic ranging shell. Its final location remains in the hit readout.

items.name: Baby Roller
items.description: Rolls and bounces down slopes; detonates on a hull or after coming to rest. A safety fuse bounds the wait.

items.name: Roller
items.description: Rolls and bounces down slopes; detonates on a hull or after coming to rest. A safety fuse bounds the wait.

items.name: Heavy Roller
items.description: Rolls and bounces down slopes; detonates on a hull or after coming to rest. A safety fuse bounds the wait.

items.name: Heavy Riot Bomb
items.description: Clears a wide crater without blast damage.

items.name: Dirt Clod
items.description: Deposits real dirt in empty cells; native particles can bury tanks and fill valleys.

items.name: Dirt Ball
items.description: Deposits real dirt in empty cells; native particles can bury tanks and fill valleys.

items.name: Ton of Dirt
items.description: Deposits real dirt in empty cells; native particles can bury tanks and fill valleys.

items.name: Liquid Dirt
items.description: Deposits real sand in empty cells; native particles can bury tanks and fill valleys.

items.name: Plasma Blast
items.description: A self-centered blast. Uses one Battery as well as one charge; aim does not change its center.

items.name: Laser
items.description: Requires custom element resolution in scripted projectile launches. Native laser material is authored; this weapon remains unavailable.
items.unavailableReason: Requires custom element resolution in scripted projectile launches. Native laser material is authored; this weapon remains unavailable.

items.name: Machine Gun
items.description: Twelve actual bullets over 0.88 seconds; one purchased magazine per turn.

items.name: Shotgun
items.description: Nine simultaneous pellets in a spread. Best at close range.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.description: A stream of actual FIRE particles over 1.4 seconds. Fire may persist after the attack.

items.name: Grenade
items.description: A bouncing three-second fused grenade.

items.name: Cluster Grenade
items.description: A fused grenade scattering five smaller live grenades.

items.name: Homing Rocket
items.description: A native steering rocket seeks the selected opponent. Deflectors can still bend metal rockets.

items.name: Smoke Tracer
items.description: A harmless ranging shell leaving a native smoke-particle trail.

items.name: Free Riot Charge
items.description: Unlimited free escape tool. A very small directional charge converts nearby terrain to smoke without damage or cash awards. Keep the large Riot Charge and Riot Blast for bigger jobs.

items.name: Riot Charge
items.description: A directional native replacement wedge. Converts eligible terrain into real SMOKE; empty air, hulls and the foundation stay untouched.

items.name: Riot Blast
items.description: A broad native replacement wedge. Converts eligible terrain into real SMOKE; empty air, hulls and the foundation stay untouched.

items.description: No configured native implementation for native underground projectile tunneling.

items.description: No configured native implementation for native underground projectile tunneling.
items.unavailableReason: No configured native implementation for native underground projectile tunneling.

items.description: No configured native implementation for wide underground projectile tunneling.
items.unavailableReason: No configured native implementation for wide underground projectile tunneling.

items.description: No configured native implementation for splitting subterranean warheads.

items.unavailableReason: No configured native implementation for splitting subterranean warheads.

items.description: No configured native implementation for large splitting subterranean warheads.
items.unavailableReason: No configured native implementation for large splitting subterranean warheads.

items.name: Dirt Charge
items.description: A directional native DIRT bank. Adds actual material to empty terrain without overwriting tanks or the foundation.

items.name: Earth Disrupter
items.description: Breaks eligible solid earth into native rigid slabs and loose debris at impact. No erasure or blast damage: gravity and contacts determine the collapse.

items.name: Heat Guidance
items.description: No configured native implementation for attach guidance to the next purchased shot.
items.unavailableReason: No configured native implementation for attach guidance to the next purchased shot.

items.name: Ballistic Guidance
items.description: Sets power for your selected angle and target using the native ballistic survey. A refused survey keeps the charge.

items.name: Horz Guidance
items.description: Turns a single rigid shell horizontally when it reaches the selected target height. Consumed when the shot launches.

items.name: Vert Guidance
items.description: Drops a single rigid shell vertically when it passes above the selected target. Consumed when the shot launches.

items.name: Lazy Boy
items.description: Sets a native ballistic firing solution. One charge only when a supported aim is found; you choose when to shoot.

items.name: Parachute
items.description: Native descent brake. One charge per deployment; early deployment slows a fall. Late deployment can still hurt.

items.name: Auto Defense
items.description: At the start of the round, automatically activates your stocked shield and mag field. Consumed only if a field activates.

items.name: Fuel Tank
items.description: Six seconds of full-speed ground propulsion. Native collision-accepted travel consumes fuel; blocked controls consume none.

items.name: Contact Trigger
items.description: Detonates a single rigid shell on its first terrain or body contact. Useful with delayed or bouncing shells.

items.name: Force Shield
items.description: Adds 2 standard shield charges to your reserve. The native field draws from that reserve.

items.name: Heavy Shield
items.description: Adds 3 standard shield charges to your reserve. The native field draws from that reserve.

items.name: Super Mag
items.description: Adds 3 standard magnet charges to your reserve. The native field draws from that reserve.
